description: This file implements a generic broadcast channel writer for the Orleans framework, allowing publishing messages to subscribers within a distributed system environment. It defines an interface for writing to the broadcast channel and a class that manages the publication process, including logging and error handling.

classes.name: IBroadcastChannelWriter
classes.description: Interface defining the method to publish an element to a broadcast channel.

classes.name: BroadcastChannelWriter
classes.description: A generic class implementing the broadcast channel writer that manages message publication to subscribers, including handling fire-and-forget delivery and logging.

methods.name: Publish
methods.description: Publishes an item to all subscribers, handling both fire-and-forget and awaited delivery modes.

methods.name: PublishToSubscriber
methods.description: Asynchronously sends the published item to a single subscriber and handles exceptions during sending.
